summary: Renders a 2D surface region with negative source offsets folded into the destination, then clipping both destination (a2,a3) and source (a5,a6) rectangles against the extent pair (a7,a8) via sub_543540. If the clipped region is non-empty (a7 > 0 and a8 > 0) it composites the surface through F_2DSurfaceCompositing using the global surface context dword_8B78A0, and clears bit 0x400 on a4[6]. Returns the region width a7 when no compositing occurs, otherwise the compositing result.

operations.description: If the source x extent a5 is negative, fold it into the destination x a2 (a2 -= a5), normalising the negative offset into the destination position.
If the source y extent a6 is negative, fold it into the destination y a3 (a3 -= a6).
Call sub_543540(&a2, &a3, &a7, &a8) to clip the destination rectangle (a2,a3) against the region extents (a7,a8), narrowing them in place.
Call sub_543540(&a5, &a6, &a7, &a8) to clip the source rectangle (a5,a6) against the same region extents.
Proceed only if the clipped region is non-empty (a7 > 0 and a8 > 0); otherwise return a7 unchanged.
Composite the clipped surface via F_2DSurfaceCompositing(dword_8B78A0, this, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7, a8, a9), passing the global surface context dword_8B78A0 and the adjusted/clipped rectangles.
Clear bit 0x400 on a4[6] (v11[6] &= ~0x400u), where v11 is the a4 pointer argument, resetting the flag after compositing.
Return the F_2DSurfaceCompositing result when the region was non-empty, or the clipped width a7 otherwise.
